ayahs.2: Qasam hai is waazeh kitaab ki.
ayahs.3: Hum ne is ko Arabi zabaan ka Quran banaaya hai ke tum samajh lo.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan yeh Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein hai aur hamare nazdeek buland martaba hikmat wali hai.
ayahs.5: Kya hum is naseehat ko tum se is bina par hata len ke tum hadd se guzar jaane wale log ho.
ayahs.6: Aur hum ne agle logon mein bhi kitne hi nabi bheje.
ayahs.7: Jo nabi un ke paas aaya unhon ne is ka mazaaq udaaya.
ayahs.8: Pas hum ne un se ziyaada zor-aawaron ko tabaah kar daala aur aglon ki misaal guzar chuki hai.
ayahs.9: Agar aap un se daryaaft karen ke aasmaanon aur zameen ko kis ne paida kiya to yaqeenan un ka jawaab yehi hoga ke unhein ghalib-o-daana (Allah) ne hi paida kiya hai.
ayahs.10: Wohi hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh (bichhauna) banaaya aur is mein tumhare liye raaste kar diye taake tum raah paa liya karo.
ayahs.11: Isi ne aasmaan se ek andaaze ke mutaabiq paani naazil farmaaya, pas hum ne is se murda shehar ko zinda kar diya. Isi tarah tum nikaale jaaoge.
ayahs.12: Jis ne tamaam cheezon ke jode banaaye aur tumhare liye kashtiyan banaayin aur chaupaaye jaanwar (paida kiye) jin par tum sawaar hote ho.
ayahs.13: Taake tum un ki peeth par jam kar sawaar hua karo phir apne Rabb ki nemat ko yaad karo jab is par theek thaak baith jaao, aur kaho paak zaat hai is ki jis ne ise hamare bas mein kar diya haalaanke hamein ise qaabu karne ki taaqat na thi.
ayahs.14: Aur bil-yaqeen hum apne Rabb ki taraf laut kar jaane wale hain.
ayahs.15: Aur unhon ne Allah ke baaz bandon ko is ka juz thehra diya yaqeenan insaan khullam-khulla naa-shukra hai.
ayahs.16: Kya Allah Taala ne apni makhlooq mein se betiyan to khud rakh leen aur tumhein beton se nawaaza.
ayahs.17: (Haalaanke) un mein se kisi ko jab is cheez ki khabar di jaaye jis ki misaal us ne (Allah) Rahman ke liye bayaan ki hai to us ka chehra siyaah pad jaata hai aur woh ghamgeen ho jaata hai.
ayahs.18: Kya (Allah ki aulaad ladkiyaan hain) jo zewaraat mein palen aur jhagde mein (apni baat) waazeh na kar saken?
ayahs.19: Aur unhon ne farishton ko jo Rahman ke ibaadat-guzaar hain auratein qaraar de liya. Kya un ki paidaaish ke mauqe par yeh maujood the? Un ki yeh gawaahi likh li jaayegi aur un se (is cheez ki) baaz-purs ki jaayegi.
ayahs.20: Aur kehte hain agar Allah chaahta to hum un ki ibaadat na karte. Unhein is ki kuch khabar nahi, yeh to sirf atkal-pachchu (jhoot baatein) kehte hain.
ayahs.21: Kya hum ne unhein is se pehle koi (aur) kitaab di hai jise yeh mazboot thaame hue hain.
ayahs.22: (Nahi nahi) balke yeh to kehte hain ke hum ne apne baap dada ko ek mazhab par paaya aur hum inhi ke naqsh-e-qadam par chal kar raah-yaafta hain.
ayahs.23: Isi tarah aap se pehle bhi hum ne jis basti mein koi daraane wala bheja wahaan ke aasooda-haal logon ne yehi jawaab diya ke hum ne apne baap dada ko (ek raah par aur) ek deen par paaya aur hum to inhi ke naqsh-e-pa ki pairwi karne wale hain.
ayahs.24: (Nabi ne) kaha bhi ke agarche main tumhare paas is se bahut behtar (maqsood tak pahunchaane wala) tareeqa le aaya hoon jis par tum ne apne baap daadon ko paaya, to unhon ne jawaab diya ke hum is ke munkir hain jise de kar tumhein bheja gaya hai.
ayahs.25: Pas hum ne un se inteqaam liya aur dekh le jhutlaane walon ka kaisa anjaam hua?
ayahs.26: Aur jabke Ibraheem (Alaihis-Salaam) ne apne waalid se aur apni qaum se farmaaya ke main in cheezon se bezaar hoon jin ki tum ibaadat karte ho.
ayahs.27: Bajuz is zaat ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai aur wohi mujhe hidayat bhi karega.
ayahs.28: Aur (Ibraheem Alaihis-Salaam) isi ko apni aulaad mein bhi baaqi rehne wali baat qaaim kar gaye taake log (shirk se) baaz aate rahen.
ayahs.29: Balke main ne in logon ko aur un ke baap daadon ko saamaan (aur asbaab) diya, yahaan tak ke un ke paas haq aur saaf saaf sunaane wala Rasool aa gaya.
ayahs.30: Aur haq ke pahunchte hi yeh bol pade ke yeh to jaadu hai aur hum is ke munkir hain.
ayahs.31: Aur kehne lage, yeh Quran in donon bastiyon mein se kisi bade aadmi par kyun na naazil kiya gaya.
ayahs.32: Kya aap ke Rabb ki rahmat ko yeh taqseem karte hain? Hum ne hi un ki zindagaani-e-dunya ki rozi un mein taqseem ki hai aur ek ko doosre se buland kiya hai taake ek doosre ko maatahat kar le jise yeh log samette phirte hain is se aap ke Rabb ki rahmat bahut hi behtar hai.
ayahs.33: Aur agar yeh baat na hoti ke tamaam log ek hi tareeqa par ho jaayenge to Rahman ke saath kufr karne walon ke gharon ki chhaton ko hum chaandi ki bana dete. Aur zeenon ko (bhi) jin par chadha karte.
ayahs.34: Aur un ke gharon ke darwaaze aur takht bhi jin par woh takiya laga laga kar baithte.
ayahs.35: Aur sone ke bhi, aur yeh sab kuch yunhi sa dunya ki zindagi ka faaida hai aur aakhirat to aap ke Rabb ke nazdeek (sirf) parhezgaaron ke liye (hi) hai.
ayahs.36: Aur jo shakhs Rahman ki yaad se ghaflat kare hum is par ek shaytaan muqarrar kar dete hain wohi is ka saathi rehta hai.
ayahs.37: Aur woh unhein raah se rokte hain aur yeh isi khayaal mein rehte hain ke yeh hidayat-yaafta hain.
ayahs.38: Yahaan tak ke jab woh hamare paas aayega kahega kaash! Mere aur tere darmiyaan mashriq aur maghrib ki doori hoti (to) bada bura saathi hai.
ayahs.39: Aur jabke tum zaalim thehar chuke to tumhein aaj har-giz tum sab ka azaab mein shareek hona koi nafa na dega.
ayahs.40: Kya pas tu behre ko suna sakta hai ya andhe ko raah dikha sakta hai aur ise jo khuli gumraahi mein ho.
ayahs.41: Pas agar hum tujhe yahaan se le bhi jaayen to bhi hum un se badla lene wale hain.
ayahs.42: Ya jo kuch un se waada kiya hai woh tujhe dikha den hum un par bhi qudrat rakhte hain.
ayahs.43: Pas jo wahi aap ki taraf ki gayi hai ise mazboot thaame rahen beshak aap raah-e-raast par hain.
ayahs.44: Aur yaqeenan yeh (khud) aap ke liye aur aap ki qaum ke liye naseehat hai aur anqareeb tum log poochhe jaaoge.
ayahs.45: Aur hamare in nabiyon se poochho! Jinhein hum ne aap se pehle bheja tha ke kya hum ne siwaaye Rahman ke aur mabood muqarrar kiye the jin ki ibaadat ki jaaye?
ayahs.46: Aur hum ne Moosa (Alaihis-Salaam) ko apni nishaaniyaan de kar Firaun aur is ke umaraa ke paas bheja to (Moosa Alaihis-Salaam ne ja kar) kaha ke main tamaam jahaanon ke Rabb ka Rasool hoon.
ayahs.47: Pas jab woh hamari nishaaniyaan le kar un ke paas aaye to woh be-saakhta un par hansne lage.
ayahs.48: Aur hum unhein jo nishaani dikhaate the woh doosri se badhi chadhi hoti thi aur hum ne unhein azaab mein pakda taake woh baaz aa jaayen.
ayahs.49: Aur unhon ne kaha aye jaadugar! Hamare liye apne Rabb se is ki dua kar jis ka is ne tujh se waada kar rakha hai, yaqeen maan ke hum raah par lag jaayenge.
ayahs.50: Phir jab hum ne woh azaab un se hata liya unhon ne isi waqt apna qaul-o-qaraar tod diya.
ayahs.51: Aur Firaun ne apni qaum mein munaadi karaayi aur kaha aye meri qaum! Kya Misr ka mulk mera nahi? Aur mere (mahalon ke) neeche yeh nehrein beh rahi hain, kya tum dekhte nahi?
ayahs.52: Balke main behtar hoon ba-nisbat is ke jo be-tauqeer hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta.
ayahs.53: Achchha is par sone ke kangan kyun nahi aa pade ya is ke saath par baandh kar farishte hi aa jaate.
ayahs.54: Us ne apni qaum ko behlaaya phuslaaya aur unhon ne isi ki maan li, yaqeenan yeh saare hi na-farmaan log the.
ayahs.55: Phir jab unhon ne hamein ghussa dilaaya to hum ne un se inteqaam liya aur sab ko dubo diya.
ayahs.56: Pas hum ne unhein gaya-guzra kar diya aur pichhlon ke liye misaal bana di.
ayahs.57: Aur jab Ibn-e-Maryam ki misaal bayaan ki gayi to is se teri qaum (khushi se) cheekhne lagi hai.
ayahs.58: Aur unhon ne kaha ke hamare mabood achchhe hain ya woh? Tujh se un ka yeh kehna mehaz jhagde ki gharaz se hai, balke yeh log hain hi jhagdaalu.
ayahs.59: Eesa (Alaihis-Salaam) bhi sirf banda hi hai jis par hum ne ehsaan kiya aur ise Bani Israeel ke liye nishaan-e-qudrat banaaya.
ayahs.60: Agar hum chaahte to tumhare iwaz farishte kar dete jo zameen mein jaanasheeni karte.
ayahs.61: Aur yaqeenan Eesa (Alaihis-Salaam) qayamat ki alaamat hai pas tum (qayamat) ke baare mein shak na karo aur meri taabedaari karo, yehi seedhi raah hai.
ayahs.62: Aur shaytaan tumhein rok na de, yaqeenan woh tumhara sareeh dushman hai.
ayahs.63: Aur jab Eesa (Alaihis-Salaam) mojize ko laaye to kaha. Ke main tumhare paas hikmat laaya hoon aur is liye aaya hoon ke jin baaz cheezon mein tum mukhtalif ho, unhein waazeh kar doon, pas tum Allah Taala se daro aur mera kaha maano.
ayahs.64: Mera aur tumhara Rabb faqat Allah Taala hi hai. Pas tum sab is ki ibaadat karo. Raah-e-raast (yehi) hai.
ayahs.65: Phir (Bani Israeel ki) jamaaton ne aapas mein ikhtilaaf kiya, pas zaalimon ke liye kharaabi hai dukh wale din ki aafat se.
ayahs.66: Yeh log sirf qayamat ke muntazir hain ke woh achaanak un par aa pade aur unhein khabar bhi na ho.
ayahs.67: Is din (gehre) dost bhi ek doosre ke dushman ban jaayenge siwaaye parhezgaaron ke.
ayahs.68: Mere bando! Aaj to tum par koi khauf (o-hiraas) hai aur na tum (bad-dil aur) ghamzada hoge.
ayahs.69: Jo hamari aayaton par imaan laaye aur the bhi woh (farmaanbardaar) musalmaan.
ayahs.70: Tum aur tumhari biwiyaan hashshaash-bashshaash (raazi khushi) jannat mein chale jaao.
ayahs.71: Un ke chaaron taraf se sone ki rakaabiyan aur sone ke glaason ka daur chalaaya jaayega, un ke jee jis cheez ki khwahish karen aur jis se un ki aankhein lazzat paayen, sab wahaan hoga aur tum is mein hamesha rahoge.
ayahs.72: Yehi woh bahisht hai ke tum apne aamaal ke badle is ke waaris banaaye gaye ho.
ayahs.73: Yahaan tumhare liye ba-kasrat meway hain jinhein tum khaate rahoge.
ayahs.74: Beshak gunaahgaar log azaab-e-dozakh mein hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.75: Yeh azaab kabhi bhi un se halka na kiya jaayega aur woh isi mein maayoos pade rahenge.
ayahs.76: Aur hum ne un par zulm nahi kiya balke yeh khud hi zaalim the.
ayahs.77: Aur pukaar pukaar kar kahenge ke aye Maalik! Tera Rabb hamara kaam hi tamaam kar de, woh kahega ke tumhein to (hamesha) rehna hai.
ayahs.78: Hum to tumhare paas haq le aaye lekin tum mein se aksar log haq se nafrat rakhne wale the?
ayahs.79: Kya unhon ne kisi kaam ka pukhta iraada kar liya hai to yaqeen maano ke hum bhi pukhta kaam karne wale hain.
ayahs.80: Kya un ka yeh khayaal hai ke hum un ki posheeda baaton ko aur un ki sargoshiyon ko nahi sunte, (yaqeenan hum baraabar sun rahe hain) balke hamare bheje hue un ke paas hi likh rahe hain.
ayahs.81: Aap keh dijiye! Ke agar bil-farz Rahman ki aulaad ho to main sab se pehle ibaadat karne wala hota.
ayahs.82: Aasmaanon aur zameen aur Arsh ka Rabb jo kuch yeh bayaan karte hain is se (bahut) paak hai.
ayahs.83: Ab aap unhein isi bahs-mubaahisa aur khel-kood mein chhod dijiye, yahaan tak ke unhein is din se saabiqa pad jaaye jin ka yeh waada diye jaate hain.
ayahs.84: Wohi aasmaanon mein mabood hai aur zameen mein bhi wohi qaabil-e-ibaadat hai aur woh badi hikmat wala aur poore ilm wala hai.
ayahs.85: Aur woh bahut barkaton wala hai jis ke paas aasmaan-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki baadshaahat hai, aur qayamat ka ilm bhi isi ke paas hai aur isi ki jaanib tum sab lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.86: Jinhein yeh log Allah ke siwa pukaarte hain woh shafaat karne ka ikhtiyaar nahi rakhte, haan (mustahiq-e-shafaat woh hain) jo haq baat ka iqraar karen aur unhein ilm bhi ho.
ayahs.87: Agar aap un se daryaaft karen ke unhein kis ne paida kiya hai? To yaqeenan yeh jawaab denge ke Allah ne, phir yeh kahaan ulte jaate hain?
ayahs.88: Aur un ka (Paighambar ka aksar) yeh kehna ke aye mere Rabb! Yaqeenan yeh woh log hain jo imaan nahi laate.
ayahs.89: Pas aap un se munh pher len aur keh den. (Achchha bhai) salaam! Unhein anqareeb (khud hi) maaloom ho jaayega.
